title: bug: JetBrains drops the daemon's PINS_UPDATED broadcast, so pins an agent adds or removes (moe.chat_pin / chat_unpin) never reach the chat panel until the channel is switched
description:
Files: moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeMessageDispatcher.kt, and new moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeMessageDispatcherPinsTest.kt. No open row declares any moe-jetbrains file. I checked the plan files and text of all 35 open rows at 2026-11-02 17:45Z, so this row is off the wrapper lane.

Origin: DONE rows promised this follow-up and nobody filed it. VSC-0 (task-a3e414a3), docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md:40 and row D7 (:73), says: "Neither client handles PINS_UPDATED ... a JetBrains-first follow-up". VSC-6 (task-9f6a725f) left it out of scope for the same reason. The VS Code half is a separate row.

Defect, read at HEAD 2bb683f8:
- Every pin write broadcasts the channel's full pin list to every /ws client. In packages/moe-daemon/src/state/chatStore.ts, pinMessage, unpinMessage and togglePinDone each emit {type:'PINS_UPDATED', payload:{channel, pins}} (:513, :530, :547). WebSocketServer.broadcast (:379) sends every StateChangeEvent to all plugin clients.
- PIN_CREATED, PIN_REMOVED and PIN_TOGGLED (WebSocketServer.ts:1128, :1142, :1156) are replies sent only to the socket that made the request. moe.chat_pin and moe.chat_unpin (tools/chatPin.ts, tools/chatUnpin.ts) produce only the broadcast.
- MoeMessageDispatcher.handle (:84) has cases for PINS (:415), PIN_CREATED, PIN_REMOVED and PIN_TOGGLED, but none for PINS_UPDATED, so that frame is dropped.
- ChatPanel.kt caches pinsByChannel and sends GET_PINS only when the selected channel changes (:141, :322). The daemon's pin-file write is a self-write that the FileWatcher skips (chatStore.ts:448), and STATE_SNAPSHOT carries no pins. Nothing else refreshes the panel.
Result: a pin a governor or agent adds with moe.chat_pin stays invisible in the JetBrains chat panel until the user switches channel and back. That includes the pinned #general lists this board uses to put questions to the human. An unpin, or a toggle made in another IDE window, behaves the same way.

Repro (this is the failing test): use the injected-lambda harness of MoeMessageDispatcherAccountsTest.kt and call dispatcher.handle with {"type":"PINS_UPDATED","payload":{"channel":"chan-1","pins":[{"messageId":"msg-1","pinnedBy":"governor-x","pinnedAt":"2026-11-02T17:00:00.000Z","done":false,"doneAt":null}]}}. Today onPins is never called.

Fix: send "PINS_UPDATED" through the same branch as "PINS". The payload has the same {channel, pins} shape, and the branch replaces the whole list through publishPins and onPins. ChatPanel.kt:237 already applies that list and redraws the selected channel.
Error handling: a malformed frame publishes nothing and never throws out of handle, the same as PINS today. Malformed means no payload object, no channel, pins that is not an array, or a pins entry that is not an object (parsePinEntry defaults missing fields, so `asJsonObject` is what throws, and the existing catch logs a warning).

Out of scope:
- VS Code: separate row.
- RESOURCE_UPDATED: neither client has a resource view, so handling it would be a feature, not this defect.
- SETTINGS_UPDATED: JetBrains doesn't handle it either, but there's no defect. updateProjectSettings writes project.json without a self-write skip, so the FileWatcher's STATE_SNAPSHOT follows each save and refreshes the settings.
- Any daemon or ChatPanel.kt change.
definitionOfDone: MoeMessageDispatcher.handle applies a PINS_UPDATED frame exactly as it applies PINS: listeners get one onPins(channel, pins) carrying the full list in payload order, and ChatPanel's existing onPins replaces that channel's pins. PINS, PIN_CREATED, PIN_REMOVED and PIN_TOGGLED behave exactly as before.
A malformed PINS_UPDATED frame publishes nothing and never throws out of handle. Malformed means no payload object, no channel, pins that is not an array, or a pins entry that is not an object.

New moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeMessageDispatcherPinsTest.kt uses the MoeMessageDispatcherAccountsTest harness and covers three cases. Two pins give one onPins call with both entries in order. An empty pins array gives onPins with an empty list, so unpinning the last pin clears the panel. Each malformed case from item 2 publishes nothing. RED first: the first two cases fail against the unchanged dispatcher, and the completion evidence quotes the failing output.

`cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits 0. Run it under the jetbrains-gradle lease (moe.acquire_resource, then release), either in place or in a snapshot of the exact commit. Its output is the complete_task evidence.
Only the two files named in the description change. No daemon, VS Code, ChatPanel.kt or MoeBundle.properties edit.

Its onState and onStatus (both abstract) and onError, onDaemonError, onPinCreated, onPinRemoved and onPinToggled each append their own name to `others: MutableList<String>`. Write three @Test methods with backtick names.
(a) Two pins. Handle {"type":"PINS_UPDATED","payload":{"channel":"chan-1","pins":[{"messageId":"msg-1","pinnedBy":"governor-x","pinnedAt":"2026-11-02T17:00:00.000Z","done":false,"doneAt":null},{"messageId":"msg-2","pinnedBy":"human","pinnedAt":"2026-11-02T17:05:00.000Z","done":true,"doneAt":"2026-11-02T17:06:00.000Z"}]}}. (b) Empty list. Handle PINS_UPDATED with channel "chan-1" and pins []. Assert assertEquals(listOf("chan-1" to emptyList<PinEntry>()), pinCalls) and that `others` is empty. This proves that unpinning the last pin clears the panel.
(c) Malformed frames, each passed to handle with NO try/catch in the test, so a throw fails the test (DoD 2). No payload key. payload null, [] and "chan-1". No channel key, and channel null. No pins key, and pins null, {} and "msg-1". pins [validPin, 42], [validPin, null], [validPin, "msg-2"] and [[]], where validPin is msg-1 from (a). The valid first entry proves that nothing is published when any entry is bad. After all frames, assert that pinCalls and `others` are both empty. Keep exactly this list. An empty-string, numeric or object channel is NOT in the DoD's malformed list, and the shared branch must keep treating it exactly as PINS does (planningNotes.risks a). Do not test those values.
(3) Run RED against the unchanged dispatcher. From WSL bash, single-quote the whole cmd string and leave the --tests filter unquoted (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-gradle-from-wsl): cmd.exe /d /c 'set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --tests com.moe.services.MoeMessageDispatcherPinsTest --rerun' 2>&1 | tee /mnt/d/moe-scratch/b9e0bb5a/red.txt (mkdir -p the dir first; it is scratch, outside the checkout). implementationPlan.description: Minimum fix, with the existing error handling (DoD 1, 2). Use the Edit tool in moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeMessageDispatcher.kt, in handle(). (1) Change the branch label `"PINS" -> {` (line 415) to `"PINS", "PINS_UPDATED" -> {`. (2) In that branch's catch, change log.warn("Failed to parse PINS payload", e) to log.warn("Failed to parse $type payload", e). The text stays identical for PINS, and a bad PINS_UPDATED is now named in the log. (3) Add one comment line above the label: PINS is the GET_PINS reply to this socket, and PINS_UPDATED is the daemon's broadcast of a channel's full pin list after every pin write (chatStore.ts pinMessage/unpinMessage/togglePinDone, including moe.chat_pin/chat_unpin), in the same {channel, pins} shape. Error handling stays the PINS path as it is. The payload, channel and pins guards return before publishing. A non-object entry makes `it.asJsonObject` throw inside the existing try, the catch logs a warning, and publishPins never runs, so nothing is published and nothing leaves handle(). Do not touch PIN_CREATED, PIN_REMOVED, PIN_TOGGLED, safeAsString, publishPins, MoeStateListener, ChatPanel.kt, MoeBundle.properties, the daemon or VS Code. Then rerun the step-1 focused command (without the tee) and expect exit 0 with 3 tests and 0 failures in build/test-results/test/TEST-com.moe.services.MoeMessageDispatcherPinsTest.xml.

implementationPlan.description: Adversarial self-review of the two-file diff (load the adversarial-self-review skill; DoD 5). (1) Scope: `git status --porcelain` and `git diff --stat` show exactly MoeMessageDispatcher.kt (modified) and MoeMessageDispatcherPinsTest.kt (new) as yours. Do not touch other seats' dirty paths. Report both files in complete_step.modifiedFiles. (2) Mutation check by reading. Each of these makes a test fail: dropping the label, mapNotNull or filter-skipping bad entries (c catches it), returning early on an empty list (b), reordering or re-parsing entries (a, full PinEntry equality), routing entries to onPinCreated (a: `others` not empty). (3) Requesting-socket double delivery: StateManager.emit is synchronous (:983), so an IDE that pins, unpins or toggles gets PINS_UPDATED and then its own PIN_CREATED/PIN_REMOVED/PIN_TOGGLED reply. ChatPanel's onPinCreated dedupes by messageId (:246), onPinRemoved's removeAll is a no-op and onPinToggled replaces the same entry, so no pin is duplicated. (4) Keys: chatStore broadcasts the channel id, and ChatPanel requests GET_PINS by channel id (:141, :322), which the reply echoes. Both land in the same pinsByChannel key. (5) Null, empty and huge inputs: the guards return before publishing. The list is parsed once, in O(n), on the receiving thread, and onPins hops to the EDT. (6) A throw out of handle() reaches MoeProjectService.onMessage's catch, which calls publishStatus(false, …), so the panel looks disconnected. Confirm that no DoD-2 frame can throw. Leave the risk-a channel values as PINS has them.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: Pins that any client or agent adds, removes or toggles (moe.chat_pin, moe.chat_unpin, toggle, or another IDE window) reach the JetBrains chat panel immediately. The daemon's PINS_UPDATED broadcast takes the same MoeMessageDispatcher branch as the PINS reply and calls onPins(channel, fullList) once. ChatPanel's existing onPins then replaces that channel's cached pins and redraws when it is the selected channel. A malformed frame publishes nothing and never throws out of handle().
acceptanceCriteria: PINS_UPDATED with two pins gives exactly one onPins("chan-1", [msg-1, msg-2]) in payload order with every PinEntry field parsed, and no other listener callback.
PINS and PINS_UPDATED with the same payload give equal onPins calls.

These frames publish nothing and do not throw: no payload or a non-object payload; a channel that is missing or null; pins that is missing, null, an object or a string; any non-object pins entry, even after a valid one.
RED: before the fix, cases (a) and (b) of MoeMessageDispatcherPinsTest fail. The completion summary quotes those failure lines.
The gradle test gate exits 0 under the jetbrains-gradle lease.
invariants: The PINS, PIN_CREATED, PIN_REMOVED and PIN_TOGGLED branches behave exactly as before, including PINS's channel coercion via safeAsString.
All-or-nothing: one non-object entry publishes nothing for the frame.
No file other than the two named changes, so there is no daemon, VS Code, ChatPanel.kt or MoeBundle.properties edit.
compatibility: Wire shape is unchanged: PINS_UPDATED {channel: channelId, pins: PinEntry[]} from chatStore.ts, the same shape as the PINS reply. Older daemons that never send PINS_UPDATED are unaffected.

New JUnit 4 class com.moe.services.MoeMessageDispatcherPinsTest with a private fakeProject() copy and a recording MoeStateListener.

moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/ChatPanel.kt:234-240 has onPins replace pinsByChannel[channel] and refresh the panel when the channel is selected.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Add PINS_UPDATED to the existing PINS branch label. Chosen: it is the fix the description names, it reuses the parser and publishPins, and the change is two lines. (2) A separate PINS_UPDATED branch with a copied parser. Rejected: duplicated code and drift. (3) Diff the broadcast list against the cache into onPinCreated/onPinRemoved/onPinToggled calls. Rejected: the frame carries the full list, so replacing it is exact and also covers toggles, and ChatPanel.onPins already replaces and redraws (:234-240). (4) Tighten channel parsing to stringOrNull. Rejected: it changes PINS's numeric and object channel behaviour, which DoD 1 forbids. (5) Have ChatPanel re-request GET_PINS on MESSAGE_CREATED or a timer. Out of scope, because DoD 5 allows no ChatPanel edit.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- Daemon chatStore.ts pinMessage, unpinMessage and togglePinDone each emit PINS_UPDATED {channel: channelId, pins} (:513, :530, :547). StateManager.emit is synchronous (:983), and WebSocketServer.broadcast (:379) sends the event to every plugin client before the requester's own reply (PIN_CREATED :1128, PIN_REMOVED :1142, PIN_TOGGLED :1156).
- The GET_PINS reply is PINS {channel: <requested>, pins} (:1114). ChatPanel requests by channel id, so both frames share a pinsByChannel key.
- MoeJson.parsePinEntry (:833) defaults missing or wrong-typed fields. Only a non-object entry throws, via asJsonObject, inside the existing try.
- MoeProjectService.onMessage (:370-379) catches whatever handle() throws and calls publishStatus(false, ex.message), so a throw looks like a disconnect.
- No JetBrains test covers PINS or PIN_* frames today.
- In headless JUnit the IntelliJ Logger is DefaultLogger: warn prints to stderr, but error would throw AssertionError. This branch uses warn.
planningNotes.risks:
(a) A channel that is a JSON object (or an array with zero or several elements) throws from safeAsString before the try, in PINS today and so in the shared branch too. A numeric channel is coerced to a string. Neither is in the DoD's malformed list: there, 'no channel' means the key is absent or JSON null, which is what PINS treats as no channel today. DoD 1 pins PINS's behaviour, so keep both cases as they are and do not test them. The daemon only ever sends a string channel id (GET_PINS also checks typeof === 'string').
(b) A peer row (864103f3, JetBrains devDependencies bundling) may edit moe-jetbrains/build.gradle.kts while you run. Only the gradle lease is shared, so use step 3's snapshot fallback if the in-place gate breaks on someone else's bytes.
(c) Stale Kotlin incremental compilation: see mem:gotcha-jetbrains-stale-kotlin-ic. No signature changes here, so it is unlikely.
(d) Pre-existing ordering edge, out of scope: when two windows toggle the same pin within milliseconds, a reply sent after the other window's later broadcast can briefly restore the older entry on the requesting socket. The next PINS_UPDATED or a channel switch corrects it, and before this fix that window never learned of the other toggle at all.
